snapshot_method: git archive of the exact commit, excluding Git metadata
integration: CourseTrainer subclasses EvolutionarySkillTrainer; original sampling, selection, prompt construction, graph validation and scope adoption are reused.
common_course_changes: Bounded initialization and per-candidate total attempts replace indefinite retries for both B and C
Fixed 100/30/50 dataset limits, population 2, max 3 rounds, max 2 candidates/round
Single fixed local model endpoint and shared token/call/GPU allocation accounting
HotpotQA supplied-context adapter and official answer-only yes/no F1 behavior
Common feedback token cap with retained selected-failure IDs
Frozen method/test boundary and complete prediction/error logs
Optional common JSON schema constraint for skill serialization on the local llama.cpp backend; QA prompts and answers remain unconstrained

For the local structured backend, a shared output-only size contract caps graph verbosity to six nodes/three task graphs within the existing 2048-token skill cap; operator temperature frozen at 0.6 after pilot diagnostics
publication_excludes: Unneeded dataset manifests except SearchQA split ID metadata
